question: Who received the Nobel Prize in 1906,for recognition of the great merits of his theoretical and experimental investigations on the conduction of electricity by gases?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sir JJ Thomson.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Nobel Prize in Physics 1906** was awarded to **Joseph John Thomson** **"in recognition of the great merits of his theoretical and experimental investigations on the conduction of electricity by gases."**
 
• Thomson was also a teacher, and **nine of his mentees** also went on to win Nobel Prizes.
 
• The experiment **Cathode Ray Tube (CRT)** conducted by** J. J. Thomson, is one of the most well-known physical experiments that led to electron discovery.**
 
• In addition, the experiment could describe **characteristic properties, in essence, its affinity to positive charge, and its charge to mass ratio.**
 
• **J.J. Thomson's experiments with cathode ray tubes** showed that **all atoms contain tiny negatively charged subatomic particles or electrons**.​​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c3c24a2e46e128d83baf4f38b04be69a326e8a4d61befe32c428e0596ec541d4.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **André-Marie Ampère**, was a French physicist who **founded and named the science of electrodynamics, now known as electromagnetism. **
 
• Albert Einstein was a German-born** theoretical physicist**, widely acknowledged to be one of the greatest and **most influential physicists of all time.**
 
• **Alessandro Volta**, was an Italian physicist whose **invention of the electric battery provided the first source of continuous current**.
